name: Magatha's Payment to Jediga
label: Quest
description: Magatha's Payment to Jediga: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this note to Jediga. Tell her the payment will be here for her when she returns. And tell her I am pleased with her work.
Go swiftly, friend. Tell your master I will be awaiting her here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Well, what did Magatha say? The old crone... I bet she was less than polite.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, good. She was much more reasonable than I expected... At least towards you. I half expected her to have you punished for my insolence in sending someone in my place. She must really want that tablet. Interesting.
